trilium-notes.description: Trilium Notes MCP Server - Comprehensive note management with 15+ tools for creating, searching, updating, and organizing notes in Trilium

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note with title, content, and parent structure

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search through notes with structured results and filtering

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieve complete note metadata and relationships

tools.name: get_note_content
tools.description: Get the raw HTML content of a note

tools.name: update_note_content
tools.description: Update the HTML content of a note directly

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note by its ID

tools.name: get_day_note
tools.description: Get or create a day note for calendar integration

tools.name: get_week_note
tools.description: Get or create a week note for calendar integration

tools.name: get_month_note
tools.description: Get or create a month note for calendar integration

tools.name: get_inbox_note
tools.description: Get the inbox note for a specific date

tools.name: create_attachment
tools.description: Create an attachment for a note

tools.name: get_app_info
tools.description: Get information about the running Trilium instance

tools.name: export_note
tools.description: Export a note subtree as ZIP file

tools.name: create_backup
tools.description: Create a database backup with a given name

metadata.documentation: Comprehensive Trilium Notes integration via ETAPI with verbose logging and error handling
